prompt.project_info: Create a clean natural portrait of an approved adult blonde woman looking over her shoulder in a white doorway.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length blonde hair, fair skin, and freckles. She wears a white ribbed long-sleeve dress with a back opening and flared sleeves, kneeling or crouching naturally while looking over her shoulder toward the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait at eye level, subject framed by a white paneled doorway, turned three-quarter back to camera with the face visible, patterned wood floor beneath, stone wall edges, and a warm interior with simple furniture behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from the doorway, gentle interior shade, realistic white fabric texture, and a calm elegant home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone-style portrait, 4:5 or 9:16 crop, natural perspective, sharp face and ribbed fabric, realistic hands and anatomy, gentle background separation, restrained color and subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a clean natural photorealistic portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with fair skin and freckles looking over her shoulder toward the camera. She wears a white ribbed long-sleeve dress with a back opening and softly flared sleeves, and kneels or crouches naturally in a white paneled doorway. Frame her from a three-quarter back angle with her face clearly visible, a patterned wood floor beneath, stone doorway edges, and a warm simple interior behind her. Use soft natural daylight, gentle interior shade, realistic fabric and skin texture, natural proportions, quiet elegant home atmosphere, and a vertical 4:5 or 9:16 crop.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, warped limbs, text, logo
